description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger A Signal-declared effect of yours fails or critically fails

Traits Paradise-Touched

The triggering effect succeeds instead, whatever the degree of its failure. You still take the force damage the failure would have dealt and still gain 1 Signal Drift, exactly as though it had failed — the cost lands on you and the effect lands on the world. What you get from a success is real, with no flat check, because it was declared Signal.

cinderfall.incomplete: Once/day: a failed/crit-failed Signal effect succeeds instead; still take the failure's damage and Drift. Converts a resolved degree of success into success after the fact -- the exact shape `AdjustDegreeOfSuccess` structurally cannot do post-roll (it evaluates in `beforePrepareData`, before the roll resolves) -- plus real Drift/damage numbers still apply. The class's Signal/Static core mechanic has no rule-element analog anywhere in pf2e-source: `AdjustDegreeOfSuccess` evaluates in `beforePrepareData`, before the roll resolves, so it cannot hook a GM's own secret post-roll check or show the player a value other than what was actually computed (`pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/adjust-degree-of-success.ts`); self-inflicted reactive damage/resource cost keyed to the resolving effect's own degree of success has no rule-element home; and no `Reroll` rule-element key exists anywhere in the compendium (`pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/ancestry/human/level-1/courteous-comeback.json` ships `rules: []`).
